mapper.select: select cm.id, cm.club_id, cm.member_id, cm.role, cm.status, cm.join_message, cm.join_time, cm.del_flag, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, coalesce(pg.level, 1) as level_id from club_member cm join club c on c.id = cm.club_id and c.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member m on m.id = cm.member_id left join player_growth pg on pg.member_id = cm.member_id where cm.club_id = #{clubId} and cm.status = 0 and cm.del_flag = 0 order by cm.join_time asc, cm.id asc

mapper.delete: delete from club_member where club_id = #{clubId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
select mem.memberId as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, m.avatar as avatar, ifnull(cleared.clearCount, 0) as clearCount, ifnull(cleared.mileage, 0) as mileage, ifnull(dur.durationMin, 0) as durationMin, ifnull(hosted.hostedCount, 0) as hostedCount from ( select cm.member_id as memberId from club_member cm join club active_club on active_club.id = cm.club_id and active_club.del_flag = 0 where cm.club_id = #{clubId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 union select c.member_id as memberId from club c where c.id = #{clubId} and c.del_flag = 0 ) mem join ums_member m on m.id = mem.memberId left join ( select pb.member_id as memberId, count(distinct t.id) as clearCount, sum(ifnull(t.total_mileage, 0)) as mileage from ( select distinct member_id, source_id from player_badge where (badge_code = 'TOPIC_CLEAR' or (source_type = 2 and badge_code = concat('TOPIC_FINISH_', source_id))) and del_flag = 0 and obtain_time >= #{sinceInclusive} ) pb join cms_topic t on t.id = pb.source_id where t.club_id = #{clubId} and t.del_flag = 0 group by pb.member_id ) cleared on cleared.memberId = mem.memberId left join ( select d.member_id as memberId, sum(d.durationMin) as durationMin from (
select p.member_id as member_id, timestampdiff(MINUTE, min(p.checkin_time), max(p.checkin_time)) as durationMin from player_node_progress p join cms_topic t2 on t2.id = p.topic_id where t2.club_id = #{clubId} and t2.del_flag = 0 and p.del_flag = 0 and p.checkin_time >= #{sinceInclusive} and exists ( select 1 from player_badge pb2 where pb2.member_id = p.member_id and pb2.source_id = p.topic_id and (pb2.badge_code = 'TOPIC_CLEAR' or (pb2.source_type = 2 and pb2.badge_code = concat('TOPIC_FINISH_', pb2.source_id))) and pb2.del_flag = 0
and pb2.obtain_time >= #{sinceInclusive} ) group by p.member_id, p.topic_id, p.activity_id ) d group by d.member_id ) dur on dur.memberId = mem.memberId left join ( select t3.member_id as memberId, count(distinct t3.id) as hostedCount from cms_topic t3 where t3.club_id = #{clubId} and t3.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from player_badge pb3 where pb3.source_id = t3.id and (pb3.badge_code = 'TOPIC_CLEAR' or (pb3.source_type = 2 and pb3.badge_code = concat('TOPIC_FINISH_', pb3.source_id))) and pb3.del_flag = 0 and pb3.obtain_time >= #{sinceInclusive} ) group by t3.member_id ) hosted on hosted.memberId = mem.memberId
